label: Live Telemetry
description: Sends live match data (positions, stats, item pickups, match events) from this instance to ql-stats-hub through the host's telemetry relay. Switch it on with the instance's Telemetry entry (telemetry-relay addon), which reserves the server ID; each feed is a separate switch below.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Master switch for everything this plugin sends. The Send telemetry switch in the instance's Telemetry menu entry sets it.

cvars.label: Position Telemetry
cvars.description: Sends player positions, view angles, weapons and accuracy for the stream overlay. Needs a Server ID.

cvars.label: Pickup Telemetry
cvars.description: Sends item pickup and drop events.

cvars.label: Session Events
cvars.description: Sends match events: chat, connects and disconnects, votes, spawns, team switches, kills, rounds, pauses, match start and end, and !call referee requests.

cvars.label: Send Interval (s)
cvars.description: Seconds between telemetry sends during normal play.

cvars.label: Idle Interval (s)
cvars.description: Seconds between sends while no player is in play.

cvars.label: Server ID
cvars.description: This instance's ID in ql-stats-hub. The instance's Telemetry menu entry reserves one and writes it here. With 0 the position feed is off and the host relay has no route for this instance.

cvars.label: Tournament ID
cvars.description: Tournament ID added to position and session data. 0 leaves it out.
